documents.title: Hand surgery: carpal tunnel
documents.text: Bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome confirmed on nerve conduction. Right release performed.

documents.title: Hand surgery: left release
documents.text: Left carpal tunnel release performed. No tissue sent for staining.

documents.title: Spine: back and leg pain
documents.text: Lumbar spinal stenosis on MRI. Decompression surgery performed.

documents.title: Neurology: numb feet
documents.text: Numbness and burning in both feet with reduced vibration sense. HbA1c 5.6%, B12 normal. Impression: idiopathic axonal neuropathy.

documents.title: Gastroenterology: bowel changes
documents.text: Alternating diarrhea and constipation with early satiety and 6 kg weight loss. Colonoscopy normal.

documents.title: Cardiology: breathlessness
documents.text: Exertional breathlessness and ankle swelling. Echocardiogram shows concentric left ventricular wall thickening of 15 mm with preserved ejection fraction. Attributed to hypertensive heart disease.

documents.title: ECG
documents.text: Sinus rhythm with low QRS voltage in limb leads.

documents.title: Light chain studies
documents.text: Serum protein electrophoresis shows no monoclonal protein. Serum free light chain ratio normal. AL amyloidosis considered unlikely.

documents.title: Primary care: dizziness
documents.text: Lightheaded on standing. Blood pressure 138/82 lying and 104/70 standing. Antihypertensive stopped. Family history: father died of heart failure at 66.

documents.title: Cardiology: follow-up
documents.text: Worsening heart failure despite blood pressure now low. Wall thickening is out of proportion to blood pressure history. No technetium pyrophosphate scan or TTR genetic testing on record.
